authorization:
사용자 원문: 그래 한 50개 만들고 전부 통과시켜
신규50종의 기술/독립 시각 검수 통과를 위해 지적 좌표를 실제로 교정하고, 이후 사용자 위임으로 Allow한다. 검수 결과를 꾸미지 않고 기존 판정을 보존한다.

issues.message: The upright shaft at x65-68, y43-49 ends against the sleeve at y50, while the open palm extends to its right at roughly x69-77, y52-55. Continue the wooden shaft through the grip to about y56 and redraw the thumb/finger skin clusters around it. Keep a visible shaft segment below the fist so the raised brush is held by the hand rather than terminating inside the cuff.

The waist hand encloses a short wood-colored stub around x44-47, y69, but the long horizontal brush shaft runs separately at y73-75. Cloth occupies the intervening rows, so the brush appears to float below the fist. Redraw the grip down onto the horizontal shaft, with thumb and fingers wrapping it near x45-49, y73-75, and remove or connect the isolated wooden stub. Preserve the other hand at the face.

The same waist-hand/shaft mismatch remains in this frame: the short wooden stub in the fist ends above the horizontal shaft at y73-75. Apply the corresponding connected grip repair near x45-49, y73-75 while retaining this frame's shifted poison bubbles and subtle posture variation.
